name: PocketMine-MP
author: info@vehosts.com
description: PocketMine-MP - Bedrock Edition Server with automatic PHP binary download and version detection.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl jq tar

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

ARCH=$([ "$(uname -m)" = "x86_64" ] && echo 'x86_64' || echo 'aarch64')

VERSION="${VERSION:-PM5}"
VERSION="${VERSION^^}"

if [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM4" ]]; then
  API_CHANNEL="4"
elif [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM5" ]]; then
  API_CHANNEL="stable"
else
  echo "Unsupported version: ${VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

# Get required PHP version from PMMP API
echo "Fetching required PHP version for ${VERSION}..."
API_RESPONSE=$(curl -sSL "https://update.pmmp.io/api?channel=${API_CHANNEL}")
PHP_VER=$(echo "$API_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.php_version')
PHAR_URL=$(echo "$API_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.download_url')
echo "Required PHP version: ${PHP_VER}"

# Download PHP binary
PHP_URL="https://github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/pm5-php-${PHP_VER}-latest/PHP-${PHP_VER}-Linux-${ARCH}-PM5.tar.gz"
echo "Downloading PHP ${PHP_VER} from GitHub..."
curl -L --progress-bar -o php.tar.gz "${PHP_URL}"
tar -xzf php.tar.gz
rm php.tar.gz

# Create symlink bin/php7 -> actual php folder (whatever version it is)
PHP_ACTUAL=$(find bin -maxdepth 1 -type d | grep -v '^bin$' | head -1)
if [ -n "$PHP_ACTUAL" ] && [ "$PHP_ACTUAL" != "bin/php7" ]; then
  echo "Creating symlink: bin/php7 -> $PHP_ACTUAL"
  ln -sfn "$(basename $PHP_ACTUAL)" bin/php7
fi
echo "PHP installed successfully!"

# Download PocketMine-MP
echo "Downloading PocketMine-MP ${VERSION}..."
curl -L --progress-bar -o PocketMine-MP.phar "${PHAR_URL}"
echo "PocketMine-MP downloaded!"

# Download default server.properties if not exists
if [[ ! -f server.properties ]]; then
  echo "Downloading default server.properties..."
  curl -sSL -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/game_eggs/minecraft/bedrock/pocketmine_mp/server.properties
fi

# Create default folders and files
echo "Creating default folder structure..."
touch banned-ips.txt banned-players.txt ops.txt white-list.txt server.log
mkdir -p players worlds plugins resource_packs

echo "PocketMine-MP Installation Complete!"
